text:
```yaml
name: Deploy

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      environment:
        description: 'Deployment Environment'
        required: true
        options:
          - azure
          - aws
          - docker
          - k8s
          - vps

jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up .NET 10.0
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v2
        with:
          dotnet-version: 10.0.x

      - name: Build ClientWeb application
        run: dotnet build ClientWeb/ClientWeb.csproj --configuration Release

      - name: Publish ClientWeb application
        run: dotnet publish ClientWeb/ClientWeb.csproj --configuration Release --output ./publish

      - name: Upload published artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v3
        with:
          name: clientweb-publish
          path: ./publish

    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && github.event.inputs.environment == 'azure'
```
